describes the intended model rather than a runnable solver workflow.

## SimplePad surface bands and local-interface correction

Start with the Q2D example to prepare local-interface field factors, then use
the Palace example to select original-parent surface bands and analyze returned
corrections. Download the shared
<a href="../notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/SurfaceBands/SimplePad/simplepad_interface_model.json" download>model JSON</a>
beside either downloaded notebook or QMD; it owns their geometry and numeric controls.

| Example | Notebook / download | Canonical source download |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SimplePad local interfaces — Q2D fields and factors | [View](../notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/SurfaceBands/SimplePad/aedt_q2d_interfaces.qmd) · <a href="../notebooks/SCGSimExamples/SurfaceBands/SimplePad/aedt_q2d_interfaces.ipynb" data-noresolveinput download>IPYNB</a> | <a href="../notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/SurfaceBands/SimplePad/aedt_q2d_interfaces.qmd" data-noresolveinput download>QMD</a> |
| SimplePad — Palace surface bands and returned Q2D correction | [View](../notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/SurfaceBands/SimplePad/palace_eigenmode_bands.qmd) · <a href="../notebooks/SCGSimExamples/SurfaceBands/SimplePad/palace_eigenmode_bands.ipynb" data-noresolveinput download>IPYNB</a> | <a href="../notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/SurfaceBands/SimplePad/palace_eigenmode_bands.qmd" data-noresolveinput download>QMD</a> |

The published RF-grounded comparison retains its original
[run-set manifest](../notebooks/ComponentSimulation/Kosen2024_Xmon/evidence/run_set.json),
[results table](../notebooks/ComponentSimulation/Kosen2024_Xmon/evidence/results.csv),
and [comparison figure](../notebooks/ComponentSimulation/Kosen2024_Xmon/evidence/comparison.png).
Read their run status and model definitions alongside any numerical comparison.

The [earlier finite-ground CPW Terminal notebook](../notebooks/ComponentSimulation/CpwFiniteGround/aedt_hfss_driven_terminal.ipynb)
uses its own geometry and runtime, separate from the resonator port-comparison pair.
